title: Exercise: Traffic Light State Machine
oneLiner: Cycle red, green and yellow with the right timings using a state variable, a CASE and one timer per state, going straight to red when Run turns off.
keyTakeaway: One INT for the state, a TON per state with IN := State = n, transitions in a CASE, and the three lamps written from the state after it.
explanation:
A traffic light is the classic state machine: three states, a timed transition out of each, and outputs that depend only on the current state. Real traffic signal controllers are certified equipment with independent conflict monitoring; this is a model for practising sequencing.

The grader runs two full cycles and checks every phase's length and order, that exactly one lamp is ever on, and what happens when Run is switched off and on again mid-cycle.
